CA.rationale: A processing/origin condition ('native_conditional_record') is explicitly bound to the candidate content red at the same referent/time.

COD.rationale: Content (red at p1/current/n1) is identified, its presentation/access is shown, and an origin/status (completed_record) is separately recorded.

A.rationale: A processing condition ('native_conditional_record') is explicitly linked to the candidate content at the same referent/time.

C.rationale: The report names specific represented content (red) with coordinates for a current referent.

D.rationale: The content identification (red at p1/current/n1) is associated with a separate status/origin field (completed_record).

O.rationale: The entry shows how the identified content is presented/accessed at a current referent (explicit coordinate listing).
